name: ZCA_ES_ENTITIES
description: This table is used to store the list of entities

columns.name: ENTITY_UUID
columns.description: the primary key for an entity within the meta-data version

columns.name: PUID_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the attribute uuid of the puid attribute of an entity.

columns.name: META_MODEL_VERSION_UUID
columns.description: the meta-data version for this entity

columns.name: ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: the name of the entity, which must be unique within the meta data version

columns.name: PROCESS_NAME
columns.description: cpq process variable name

columns.name: VERSION
columns.description: deployed version used while resyncing cpq process and attributes in fa metamodel

columns.name: RI_OBJECT_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: the object type used in recent items if this is a top-level searchable object

columns.name: FUNCTIONAL_PERMISSION_NAME
columns.description: the name of the functional permission required to view this object, if any

columns.name: PRIMARY_ENTITY_USAGE_UUID
columns.description: the uuid of the primary entity usage for this entity

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the attribute uuid that is the primary key for an entity

columns.name: REST_RESOURCE_NAME
columns.description: the name of the ADF bc REST resource name

columns.name: REST_PK_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the ADF bc REST primary key atribute

columns.name: EXTN_JOIN_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the uuid of the attribute that is used to join with custom child objects

columns.name: DISPLAY_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the attribute uuid that is used as the display for the entity

columns.name: INLINE_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the uuid of the inline attribute whose foreign key represents the entity that this entity extends

columns.name: RECORD_SET_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the attribute uuid that is used for implementing the record set for a top-level entity

columns.name: VERSION_NUMBER_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the attribute uuid that contains the object version number for this entity, if any

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the attribute uuid that is contains the last update attribute for this entity, if any

columns.name: USER_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the attribute uuid that defines the user if this entity is a user entity

columns.name: START_DATE_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the attribute uuid that defines the start date if this is a date-effective entity

columns.name: END_DATE_ATTRIBUTE_UUID
columns.description: the attribute uuid that defines the end date if this is a date-effective entity

columns.name: CAN_BE_ENABLED_DISABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the top-level entity can be enabled/disabled as child entities can never be disabled.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the entity is enabled

columns.name: DOCUMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the entity is a top-level document

columns.name: MAX_AGE_IN_DAYS
columns.description: The maximum age in days for the documents in a top-level index where NULL indicates all documents are retained

columns.name: MAX_AGE_EXCLUSION_FILTER
columns.description: An exclusion filter to specify rows where MAX_AGE_IN_DAYS does not apply.

columns.name: MAX_AGE_EXCL_RES_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: The string to display the max age exclusion filter.

columns.name: MAX_AGE_EXCL_RES_KEY_NAME
columns.description: The resource key to display the max age exclusion filter.

columns.name: TRANSIENT_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the entity is a transient entity, i.e., not grounded in the database

columns.name: EXTN_ENTITY_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the entity is an extension entity

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_SHARDS
columns.description: the number of shards > 1 < 5

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_REPLICAS
columns.description: the number of replicas > 1 <= NUMBER_OF_SHARDS

columns.name: RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: the resource bundle to use for localization

columns.name: RESOURCE_KEY_NAME
columns.description: the resource key in the RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized name

columns.name: RESOURCE_KEY_PLURAL_NAME
columns.description: the resource key in the RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized plural name

columns.name: RESOURCE_KEY_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: the resource key in the RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized description

columns.name: RESOURCE_KEY_HELP
columns.description: the resource key in the RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized help

columns.name: EXTN_RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: the customized resource bundle to use for localization

columns.name: EXTN_RESOURCE_KEY_NAME
columns.description: the resource key in the EXTN_RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized name

columns.name: EXTN_RESOURCE_KEY_PLURAL_NAME
columns.description: the resource key in the EXTN_RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized plural name

columns.name: EXTN_RESOURCE_KEY_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: the resource key in the EXTN_RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized description

columns.name: EXTN_RESOURCE_KEY_HELP
columns.description: the resource key in the EXTN_RESOURCE_BUNDLE_ID for the localized help

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Y iff the row was deleted, otherwise N

columns.name: SELECTED_PUBLISH_TYPE
columns.description: SELECTED_PUBLISH_TYPE

columns.name: CATEGORY
columns.description: CATEGORY

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CODE
columns.description: Column to store the product team code for the entity

columns.name: ALLOW_CRAWL_REFERENCES_FLAG
columns.description: Y if this root entity may have references included during crawl, otherwise N
